scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "pnpm run build:watch" "sleep 1 && pnpm run tic80:run"
scripts.export:linux: pnpm run tic80 --cmd "load build/cart.js & cd export & export linux linux & exit"
scripts.export:mac: pnpm run tic80 --cmd "load build/cart.js & cd export & export mac mac & exit"
scripts.export:win: pnpm run tic80 --cmd "load build/cart.js & cd export & export win win & exit"
scripts.export:html: pnpm run tic80 --cmd "load build/cart.js & cd export & export html html & exit"
